# Vendored third-party skills

Everything under this folder is someone else's open-source work, copied unmodified with its license and an `ATTRIBUTION.md`. Do not present any of it as Agency Zero's own work, and do not delete the attribution files.

| Folder | Source | License |
|---|---|---|
| `claude-seo/` | https://github.com/AgriciDaniel/claude-seo | MIT |
| `open-seo-mcp-skills/` | https://github.com/Ryze-AI-Adgent/open-seo-mcp-skills | MIT |
| `egeoagents/` | https://github.com/mverab/eGEOagents | MIT |
| `geo-optimizer/` | https://github.com/Auriti-Labs/geo-optimizer-skill | MIT |
| `seo-intelligence/` | https://github.com/Trementdv/seo-intelligence-skill | MIT |

## Requested but not copied

**Illyism/seo-skills** (https://github.com/Illyism/seo-skills): `seo-autopilot`, `blitz-seo`, `blog-refresher`, `customer-journey`. The repository has **no license file** (checked 2026-10-23), so copying or redistributing it is not permitted. The concepts (daily autopilot, 30-day single-page sprint, page refresh, customer-journey query mapping) are covered by this repo's own original workflows, which credit the idea source: `workflows/sprint-and-autopilot.md`, `workflows/customer-journey.md`, and the refresh section of `workflows/content-strategy.md`. To use the upstream files themselves, ask the author to add a license, or install them from the upstream repository for personal use.

## Updating

Re-copy from upstream, update the commit in `ATTRIBUTION.md`, and read the diff for changed tool calls or instructions before committing.
